_comment: Instance data for core/helpers/close-loss-gate.cjs: regexes in the operator's own language.
release_patterns: a phrase that releases the operator ('you can shut down'); hand_patterns: a word that marks
a step only the operator's hand can take. English built-ins stay in force; these lists extend them.
negation_words: words of the operator's language that negate a hand word right after them ('no hand step');
the gate skips such a match for every pattern, so a hand pattern needs no lookbehind of its own.
